title: Close nonconformance
purpose: Close a nonconformance once it is in Verification with its impact decided, its actions finished and an effectiveness check that allows closing.
summary: Close a nonconformance once its work is done and checked. Only a supervisor who is not the record's owner can close it.

tasks.title: Close the record
steps: Explain why it can close in [[Closing note]] and select [[Close nonconformance]].

tasks.title: Find out why it cannot close yet
steps: Read the [[Not ready to close]] notice on this form, or the Closing section on the record. It names the next thing to do.

good_to_know: Closing needs Verification, the decision on reported results, no open actions and an Effective or No corrective action needed check.
If reported results are affected, whether the client was told must be recorded first.
The owner cannot close their own record, even as a supervisor. Another supervisor closes it.
The form shows what you close: the decision on reported results, what was reviewed, whether the client was told, the actions and the effectiveness check.
A closed record does not change. A supervisor can reopen it with a reason.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Only a supervisor (the admin role included) may open this form; anyone else is refused. It opens from Close nonconformance at the top of the record, as a dialog or a full page. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

items.label: Not ready to close
items.description: A warning at the top of the form when the record cannot close now, with the reason.

items.label: Closing note
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Why the record can close. Shown in the record's Closing section.

items.label: Close nonconformance
items.description: Closes the record, records you and the time, and confirms Nonconformance closed. The history records Closed with the status before and after.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without changing anything.

sections.title: Conditions
paragraphs: Every condition is checked again when you save, in this order. The first one not met is the reason shown.

items.label: Choose its owner first.
items.description: The record has no owner yet.

items.label: You own this nonconformance, so another supervisor closes it.
items.description: The owner never closes their own record.

items.label: Record the decision on reported results first.
items.description: The decision on reported results must be recorded.

items.label: Record whether the client was told first.
items.description: When reported results are affected, Client told must be Client told or No need to tell a client.

items.label: Finish or cancel its open actions first.
items.description: Every action must be done or cancelled.

items.label: Record an effectiveness check that allows closing first.
items.description: The effectiveness result must be Effective or No corrective action needed.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Your note is kept on the form.

items.label: Signed out by a time limit
items.description: When a time limit signs you out, what you typed here is kept for 24 hours, for you in that browser only, and comes back on this page when you sign in again there (a form open in a dialog opens again on its own page). It keeps the version of the record you typed against: if the record changed since, the page says This record changed after you typed it, and saving is refused with your typing on the form. Copy what you need, then select Discard to open the form as the record stands. It comes back even where the form is no longer offered, for example after the record was closed.
